summary: Ensysce Biosciences acquired Cy Biopharma via a two-step merger on August 5, 2026, issuing 282,122 shares of Series C Preferred Stock (each convertible into 1,000 common shares) to Cy's equityholders. The deal is structured as a tax-free reorganization, with Cy becoming a wholly owned subsidiary. Series C conversion is subject to stockholder approval at a future meeting, including a Nasdaq-required conversion proposal and possible charter amendment. No advisors, premiums, or deal value were disclosed. Watch for stockholder approval timing and conversion mechanics.
